svg.title: Proposed portrait gameplay screen: overview, building, and trading
svg.desc: Three schematic 390 by 844 safe-content views. The overview keeps players, board, private resources, and phase actions visible. Building and trading use focused bottom sheets. Future rule features are illustrative and are not currently implemented.
